question: How do EnergyManager2 load name/mode/icon setters update value, customization flags and explicit reset/clear state?
scope: Semantic summaries of frozen decompilation, not original vendor source, GUI execution, runtime parity or proof of dialog ownership.

anchors.relation: CLoad setter: column2 writes mode at +0x94 if changed and unconditionally sets Anc at +0xac to1; column4 assigns name at +0x50 and unconditionally sets Ncu at +0x68 to1. Column3 parses icon into +0x98..+0xa7; an available buffer with a nonmatching UUID clears those16 bytes. No icon customization marker is written by this branch.
Name assignment converts QString to UTF8 and copies the string, including a successfully converted empty string. No inferred inherited name is substituted.
Load XML transfer binds Na/Ncu/An/Anc/ico to CLoad +0x50/+0x68/+0x94/+0xac/+0x98. Na uses string type15 with omit-empty argument0. Boolean markers and icon use omit-default argument1.
Writer string type15 returns early for an empty string only when argument6 is nonzero. Therefore the Energy Na binding retains Na="" on clear.

Writer UUID type25 omits the nil UUID when argument6 is nonzero; the Energy icon binding sets that argument. Explicit CLI icon clear therefore removes only ico, not name/mode flags or icon definitions.

Connected-output refresh enters mode/name inheritance only when Anc at +0xac is0; name refresh additionally requires Ncu at +0x68 to be0. Clearing a name or selecting Digital through the direct setter does not satisfy those gates.

clear_contract.cli: lox config energy load set FILE BLOCK LOAD_ID --no-name
clear_contract.name: Store Na="" and Ncu="true". Omitted name action preserves existing storage. --name and --no-name conflict, including an explicit empty --name.
clear_contract.mode: Selecting Digital makes An false/omitted but retains Anc=true, including an unchanged Digital selection; this is not inherited-mode reset.
clear_contract.icon: Explicit --no-icon omits ico and preserves Na/Ncu/An/Anc. Omitted icon action preserves the exact existing reference, including unknown references.
clear_contract.reset_to_inherited: Unsupported. Do not clear Ncu/Anc by guessing a default name or mode.

assumptions: The direct function receives a valid CLoad receiver and the stated column identifier.
Normal successful Qt/string conversion and allocation; allocation-failure behavior is not reproduced by the CLI.
Native UUID parser behavior is summarized conditionally on a nonnull parser buffer; the CLI still rejects malformed icon selections instead of silently clearing.

remaining_dependency.caller_dependency: A dedicated restore-inherited operation would need an identified caller that explicitly clears those markers before the connected-output refresh, plus a resolved connected source for its virtual mode and name reads. No such reset caller is established by this slice.
remaining_dependency.native_validation_question: In an owned offline Config project, does an accepted empty-name edit save/reopen as Na="" with Ncu=true while preserving all load identities, mode customization and icon references? This is follow-up validation, not an implementation prerequisite.
